meta.title: Human joint table for code-driven rigs
meta.convention: Each movement is the named anatomical motion measured from anatomical position (0). [min,max] are angles of that motion; negative min means motion past neutral in the opposite direction (e.g. elbow flexion min -5 = 5 deg hyperextension). Bilateral motions (lateral flexion, rotation, deviation) are per side.
meta.humerothoracic_note: Shoulder values are humerothoracic (arm vs trunk) and include scapular motion. Split with the scapulohumeral rhythm if the rig has a scapula/clavicle bone.
meta.status_values: verified = number read in a cited source; derived = arithmetic on cited numbers; unverified = not confirmed in a source read during this research; null = no value

neck.type: composite: C0-C1 condylar rocking + C1-C2 pivot + subaxial plane facets
coupled_rules: About half or more of neck axial rotation occurs at C1-C2; C0-C1 mainly nods (unverified share).
Subaxial cervical lateral bending couples with same-side axial rotation [LIEBSCH2025].
All cervical motions decline with age [YOUDAS1992].

thoracolumbar_spine.type: chain of plane facet joints + intervertebral discs

flexion.note: LUTT lists 45-50. Gates 59 is total trunk flexion-extension excursion across ADLs. Esola: lumbar contributed 41.6 of a 111 total forward bend.

axial_rotation.note: Lumbar rotation largely prevented; thoracic carries most twist [OS96]. Gates trunk rotation may include pelvis.

coupled_rules: Lumbopelvic rhythm in forward bending: lumbar-to-hip ratio 1.9 (0-30 deg), 0.9 (30-60), 0.4 (60-90) [ESOLA1996].
Distribute bend across segments; no single spine bone should hold most of the bend (heuristic).
Lateral bending and axial rotation are coupled; lumbar direction inconsistent, do not hard-code [LIEBSCH2025].

scapula.type: compound girdle: sternoclavicular saddle + acromioclavicular plane + scapulothoracic glide

upward_rotation.note: 60 = 180 total elevation / 3 under 2:1. ~50 under Braman 2.3:1. Functional 33 = Gates 108 humeral elevation / 3.3.

coupled_rules: Scapulohumeral rhythm ~2:1 glenohumeral:scapular after a ~30 deg setting phase [INMAN_via_OUHSC][OUHSC_SCAP].
In vivo ratio 2.3 raising, 2.7 lowering; scapula upward-rotates ~0.43 deg per deg of GH elevation [BRAMAN2009].
Posterior tilt and upward rotation increase to max elevation; scapula internally rotates up to ~125 deg GH elevation then externally [BRAMAN2009].
Validator band (heuristic): if humerothoracic elevation E > 30, scapular upward rotation in [(E-30)/3.5, (E-30)/1.5].

flexion.note: CDC means 168.8 M / 172.0 F (20-44 y); LUTT 180. Gates humeral elevation 0-108.

adduction.note: Cross-body (horizontal) adduction functional 116 [NAMDARI2012] is a different measure.

medial_rotation.note: Gates 79 hand-to-back-pocket. Namdari 102 measured arm at side (different position).

coupled_rules: Split humerothoracic elevation ~2:1 between glenohumeral and scapula (see scapula).
Glenohumeral-only elevation ~120 of 180 (derived).
Lateral humeral rotation needed for full abduction (unverified).
Use swing-twist cone limits, not independent Euler limits (heuristic).

flexion.note: CDC flexion means 144.6 M / 150.0 F; CDC 'extension' means 0.8 M / 4.7 F read here as hyperextension (sign undefined on page). Gates: drinking needed 121; some tasks need near-full extension.

coupled_rules: Biceps flexes and supinates; strong palm-up lifts show slight supination [OS115].
At impact keep 5-15 deg flexion, not locked (heuristic).
IK soft-limit reach at <=0.99 chain length (heuristic).

pronation.note: From mid-position. CDC 76.9 M / 82.0 F. Gates ADLs peaked at 13.

coupled_rules: Palm rotation = forearm pronation/supination + humeral rotation; check each against its own limit (unverified total).
Wrist joint carries no axial twist; put twist on forearm twist bones near the wrist (heuristic).

flexion.note: Ryu: 54 max used; ~40 suffices for most tasks. Gates 38. Other charts list up to 80-90 (unverified).

ulnar_deviation.note: Functional exceeds LUTT clinical; LUTT is conservative. Gates 38.

coupled_rules: Limit (flexion, deviation) jointly as an ellipse, not a box (heuristic).
Dart-thrower path: extension+radial to flexion+ulnar (unverified).
Grip strongest with slight wrist extension (unverified).

flexion.note: CDC 130.4 M / 133.8 F (passive). LUTT 100 (likely knee-straight). Walking ~30 at heel contact.

extension.note: CDC 17.4 M / 18.1 F; LUTT 30. Gait 10-15 before toe-off.

coupled_rules: Hips dominate late forward bending (lumbar:hip 0.4 at 60-90 deg) [ESOLA1996].
Hamstrings (hip ext + knee flex) and rectus femoris (hip flex + knee ext) couple hip and knee [OS116, inferred].
Hip extension ligament-limited near vertical [OS96].
Knee direction within ~15-20 deg of foot direction in squats/landings (heuristic).

knee.type: modified hinge (axial rotation only when flexed)

flexion.note: CDC 137.7 M / 141.9 F; LUTT 150. Rowe: gait <90, stairs/chairs 90-120, bath ~135. Hyodo crouch 149. Walking swing ~60. CDC 'extension' 1.0 M / 1.6 F, sign undefined.

tibial_axial_rotation.note: Existence in flexion only is verified [OS96]; magnitudes unverified.

coupled_rules: Screw-home: tibia externally rotates on femur over last ~20 deg of extension; reverses at start of flexion (popliteus) [OS96][OUHSC_KNEE]. Magnitude ~10-15 deg unverified.
Never locked under load after landing contact; flexion increases for several frames (heuristic).
Gastrocnemius couples knee flexion and ankle plantarflexion [OS116, inferred].

dorsiflexion.note: CDC 12.7 M / 13.8 F; commonly quoted ~20 (unverified). LUTT page lists 30 (likely swapped). Deep squats need more (unverified).

plantarflexion.note: CDC 54.6 M / 62.1 F. Gait 15-20 before push-off.

coupled_rules: Talocrural joint allows only dorsi/plantarflexion; side motion blocked by malleoli [OS96].
Inversion/eversion belong to the subtalar bone, never the ankle hinge [OS95][OS96].
With knee straight, gastrocnemius reduces dorsiflexion (unverified magnitude).
Landing: dorsiflexion increases after contact (heuristic).

subtalar.type: plane/gliding intertarsal complex (subtalar + transverse tarsal) acting as one oblique axis

inversion.note: Inversion > eversion is verified [OS95]. Milgrom 1985 means 22-32 by technique (snippet only).

coupled_rules: Inversion range exceeds eversion [OS95].
Weight-bearing subtalar pronation couples with internal tibial rotation, supination with external (unverified).
